d: Noble Panacea is a new revolutionary skincare brand, founded by Nobel Laureate Sir Fraser Stoddart, launched in October 2019. The ground-breaking OSMV™ Technology at the core of the brand enables transformational efficacy and precision. We create with intention and deep respect by adhering to the global principles of green chemistry. We take our commitment to nature and sustainability to all stages of product development, from R&D; to packaging. Ultimately, we strive to promote absolute skin health by empowering all who seek authentic, natural, and ageless beauty.

We are looking for a highly motivated, experienced, and service-oriented Beauty Advisor & Aesthetician. As a Noble Panacea Beauty Advisor & Aesthetician, you will represent the brand and offer in-depth knowledge of our products and technology. You will be responsible for sales performance, daily operations of the counter with emphasis on performing facials, personalized customer service, clienteling, and follow-up. You will provide welcoming, authentic, and personalized service to achieve all customer service and sales targets. With your passion for people; the environment and company; products and services, you will ensure that each customer has a unique and memorable in-store experience which educates, inspires, and delights them.

You will also use your exceptional people skills to build collaborative working relationships with the rest of your team to ensure that the counter along with the treatment room meet Noble Panacea’s high standards of visual merchandising. If you are passionate about beauty and luxury and an ambitious self-starter looking for a progressive career within the Retail Beauty Industry, then this could be the perfect role for you and a great opportunity to be part of a dynamic and passionate team.
q: 5 years of experience working as a Beauty Advisor
Experience preferably with luxury/niche skincare brands
r: Present Noble Panacea to clients, educate and share product knowledge about OSMV™ technology, ingredients, features & benefits and demonstrate when necessary, according to the unique brand protocol.
Expertly perform Noble Panacea facial protocols daily and during events to deliver a luxurious experience and foster client loyalty.
Be aware of new skincare trends and integrate them into customer conversations.
Provide passion for beauty and excellent customer service at all times.
Show proactive behavior, especially during quiet periods, to maximize productivity.
Be sales target-oriented with proven experience in achieving year-on-year growth.
Demonstrate self-confidence and professionalism in all client interactions.
Display a resolutive and ambitious approach, working as part of a team to achieve both personal and team goals.
Build loyalty by recruiting new clients and maintaining them in the CRM system.
Develop strong social skills and maintain positive relationships with clients and Harrods staff.
Communicate clearly and frequently with Sales and Education Manager to ensure effective brand support.
Ensure floor presentation meets Noble Panacea’s brand guidelines.
Maintain detailed business and treatment records for forecasting and planning.
Act as Noble Panacea brand ambassador in-store to promote awareness and inter-sell.
Be self-driven, adaptable, and resilient in a fast-paced, competitive retail environment.

d: At Rotana, we are passionate about our people and committed to creating a rewarding workplace where colleagues can grow, perform and build meaningful careers.

We are looking for an experienced Director of Compensation & Benefits to join our Corporate Talent & Culture team. Reporting to the Corporate Vice President – Talent & Culture, you will lead Rotana’s Total Rewards strategy across our corporate office and international portfolio of operating and pre-opening hotels, ensuring our compensation and benefits practices remain competitive, equitable, performance-driven and aligned with our business and Employee Value Proposition.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance or a related field.
Significant leadership experience in Compensation & Benefits / Total Rewards, ideally within a large, multi-country organisation.
Strong knowledge of compensation benchmarking, job evaluation, grading and salary structures.
Proven experience with executive compensation, incentive schemes and annual reward cycles.
Strong analytical capability with experience using HRIS, payroll and compensation data.
Good understanding of benefits, pay equity, reward governance and regulatory compliance across different markets.
Strong commercial acumen with the confidence to advise and influence senior leadership.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and decision-making skills.
Experience within hospitality or a multi-site international organisation would be an advantage.
If you are passionate about building reward strategies that recognise performance, strengthen the colleague experience and support business growth, we would be delighted to hear from you.
r: Lead Rotana’s Total Rewards strategy across corporate, operating and pre-opening hotels.
Develop and maintain compensation philosophy, grading structures, job architecture and reward governance.
Lead market benchmarking, salary surveys and job evaluations to ensure competitive positioning and internal equity.
Manage executive compensation programmes, including STIP, LTIP and retention frameworks.
Oversee annual salary reviews, merit increases, bonuses and incentive cycles across multiple markets.
Provide strategic oversight of employee benefits and wellbeing programmes, ensuring alignment with Rotana’s EVP.
Develop compensation, benefits, incentives and manpower budgets for new hotel openings.
Partner with senior leadership, General Managers and HR leaders on reward strategies and recommendations.
Use HRIS, payroll and market data to identify trends and provide meaningful reward insights.
Ensure compliance with local labour legislation, pay-equity principles and corporate governance requirements across all markets.

d: Company Description Fabrum is a Kuwait-based turn-key fit-out and interior contracting firm with over 100 completed projects across healthcare, laboratories, commercial, hospitality, and infrastructure sectors. The company integrates design, engineering, and project management into one accountable partner, ensuring cohesive delivery from concept to completion. Fabrum focuses on transforming spaces into high-performance environments that are both functional and visually compelling. Team members contribute to projects that shape modern infrastructure and built environments in Kuwait and the wider region.

Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Driver role based in Kuwait City. The Driver will be responsible for safely operating company trucks to transport materials, equipment, and furnishings to and from project sites, following all traffic laws and company safety procedures. Daily tasks include performing basic vehicle inspections, reporting maintenance needs, keeping accurate delivery documentation, and ensuring timely pickups and drop-offs. The Driver will coordinate with project managers, warehouse staff, and site teams to support smooth project operations and may assist with loading and unloading materials when needed. Professional conduct and respectful interactions with clients, suppliers, and colleagues are essential.
q: Truck Driving and Truck operation skills for safe, efficient transport of materials and equipment.
Valid CDL Class A or equivalent heavy vehicle license, with a strong record of compliant driving.
Clear Communication skills to coordinate with project teams, site personnel, and logistics staff.
Customer Service skills to represent Fabrum professionally when interacting with clients and partners.
Knowledge of local traffic regulations and routes in Kuwait City and surrounding areas.
Ability to perform basic vehicle checks and report maintenance or safety concerns promptly.
Prior experience as a professional driver in construction, fit-out, or logistics environments is an advantage.
Reliability, punctuality, and the ability to work flexible hours based on project needs.

d: Risk Director / Chief Risk Officer (Regulated Financial Services) – Bahrain

DCS Card Centre is a financial institution founded in 1973 and formerly known as Diners Club Singapore. We bring decades of expertise and commitment to payments, and innovative digital solutions to DeCard.

With a strong heritage rooted in the space, our expertise in delivering secure, reliable, and cutting-edge payment solutions is licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) and governed under the Banking Act.
Functionally to the Board of Directors and Board Risk Committee
CBB-approved Senior Management / Controlled Function covering
The CRO will lead the Company's independent Risk Management function across its regulated PSP and crypto-asset businesses in Bahrain.

The role is responsible for establishing and maintaining the enterprise risk management framework, risk appetite, policies, controls, monitoring, reporting, and governance processes. The CRO will advise and challenge senior management on all material risks while ensuring compliance with Central Bank of Bahrain (CBB) requirements.
q: 8+ years of risk management experience within regulated financial services.
Experience in payments, fintech, banking, capital markets, digital assets, or crypto businesses.
Previous experience leading a risk management function.
Direct exposure to PSP, electronic payments, card payments, acquiring, issuing, or crypto businesses is highly preferred.
Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Risk Management, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics, Business, or related discipline.
Operational, Liquidity, Market, Counterparty and Cyber Risk
Strong Board and regulator-facing communication skills
Knowledge of Bahrain regulatory environment and CBB requirements
Strong stakeholder management skills with the confidence to influence executive decision-making
Proven leadership and team management capability.
Experience working with both payments and digital asset businesses.
Capable of engaging effectively with Boards
Learn more on LinkedIn Decard & website: DCS Card Centre
r: Develop and maintain the enterprise-wide risk management framework.
Identify, assess, monitor, mitigate, and report material risks.
Maintain risk registers, KRIs, risk limits, and escalation processes.
Drive a strong risk culture across the organization.
Recommend and monitor risk appetite and risk limits.
Independently challenge business decisions that may create excessive risk.
Escalate material risk issues directly to the Board and Risk Committee when required.
Conduct risk assessments for new products, services, markets, technology changes, and outsourcing arrangements.
Provide independent risk review and approval recommendations.
Develop risk limits and stress-testing frameworks.
Monitor financial resilience and counterparty exposure.
Present stress-testing results and recommendations to senior management and the Board.
Maintain compliance with CBB risk management requirements.
Support regulatory inspections, reviews, and licensing matters.
Prepare Board and Risk Committee reports on risk exposures, incidents, emerging risks, and remediation activities.
Lead and develop the Risk Management team.
Ensure adequate resources, systems, governance, and expertise.
Collaborate with Compliance, MLRO, Internal Audit, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams.
